change_summary: MCU internal DIO peripheral driver architecture pattern.
family_pattern: IoMcu (MCU internal peripheral, no external chip)

key_characteristics.mainfunction_reason: IoMcu APIs are synchronous — read/write directly without periodic polling
key_characteristics.api_style: Synchronous resource wrapper (no MainFunction by default)
key_characteristics.dependency_selection_style: Signal ID mapping macros for logical-to-physical routing

external_apis.name: Gp_IoMcuDio_Init
external_apis.description: Initializes DIO module, loads config, sets default pin directions.

external_apis.name: Gp_IoMcuDio_SetOutputLevel
external_apis.description: Sets output level for a logical DIO signal. Internal mapping resolves CoreId+Channel from Id.

external_apis.name: Gp_IoMcuDio_GetInputLevel
external_apis.description: Reads input level from a logical DIO signal.

external_apis.name: Gp_IoMcuDio_GetXxxSigDiag
external_apis.description: Returns diagnostic status for a DIO signal. IoMcu uses GetXxxSigDiag naming (not GetDevFaultSig).

dependency_apis.name: Gp_IoMcuDio_CalloutDioWrite
dependency_apis.description: Writes physical DIO output via MCAL port.

dependency_apis.name: Gp_IoMcuDio_CalloutDioRead
dependency_apis.description: Reads physical DIO input via MCAL port.

config_macros.name: GP_IOMCUDIO_CFG_DIO_ID_<SIGNAL>
config_macros.purpose: Signal ID mapping macros in Cfg.h (IoMcu pattern: many signal-ID macros).

runtime_states.name: InitState
runtime_states.read_write_side: Written by Init; read by all APIs.
runtime_states.lifecycle: Set on Init; checked on each API call.

runtime_states.name: DET buffer (per core)
runtime_states.read_write_side: Written by all APIs on DET errors.
